alerts.text: What changed since the 14 Nov 20:55 report: nothing that moves the plan. I re-ran the collector and optimiser and re-checked injury news for all 10 players, Procida and Brizuela. The optimiser ranking is identical (A 6.3%, your trades 5.4%).
Fix the app lineup whatever you do: Herrera was your 6th man. Use 3-1-1: Robinson, Nunn, Feliz / Vezenkov (C) / Diarra, with Malcolm as 6th man.

Domestic games are today (15 Nov), after this report: Panathinaikos–Kolossos 13:00 Athens, Aris–Olympiacos, Barça–Obradoiro 17:00, Baskonia–Real Madrid 19:00, Fenerbahçe–Efes 20:30 Istanbul. Check on Monday that Vezenkov, Nunn, Robinson, Feliz and Malcolm came through. A DNP right before the double week is probably rest, which is fine; an injury exit is not.

Undo check: the site still shows pre-R11 prices, and the app's are 0.1–0.4 higher. After undoing Brizuela → Herrera, check that Procida fits in the bank you see. If he doesn't, keep your trades (Variation B).
Only Real Madrid play on Wednesday (at Beşiktaş). Every other R12 game is Tuesday, so Feliz (and Procida in A) are your only late options for the armband or a swap.
R13 plan (4 new trades after Wednesday's games): Nunn → Payne, coach Masiulis (ZAL) → Albert (VBC), Feliz → Loyd, and Joksimović → Tyson Ward. It'll be redone after R12.
No bookmaker key, and no line is posted yet for Zalgiris–Bayern. The site's 79% matches last March's −400 for the same fixture, so Masiulis (ZAL) stays the coach pick.

rumours.text: Milan are closing the signing of center Ze'Rik Onyema from Scafati (about €450k buy-out). Not official yet; the aim is to have him for Zvezda on Tuesday.
rumours.impact: If he's registered in time, Diop's 15 minutes could shrink in R12 already. That's the main risk in A and B, and why Diop is a sell in the R14 window.

rumours.text: Gazzetta.gr: Zalgiris offered a Moses Wright for Maodo Lo swap and Milan said no. Milan may also look at wing Lester Quiñones.
rumours.impact: None for now. If Wright left Zalgiris, Valančiūnas gets even more frontcourt minutes.

rumours.text: John Konchar is said to be unhappy with his role and life in Greece and is thinking about leaving (press headlines; Olympiacos also have a foreign-player limit problem in the Greek league).
rumours.impact: Small. Konchar is a bench wing; if he leaves, Tyson Ward gets more minutes (he's the R13 bench buy). No effect on Vezenkov.

rumours.text: Milutinov fractured the tip of his right index finger and misses Aris (Sunday) and Maccabi (Tuesday); return expected around 24 Nov. Papanikolaou is back.
rumours.impact: More touches and rebounds for Vezenkov in R12, your captain.

rumours.text: Bruno Fernando is out 3–4 weeks with a calf injury.
rumours.impact: More frontcourt usage for Malcolm and Saric; it supports keeping Malcolm as 6th man.

rumours.text: Chris Silva (from Fenerbahçe) was due to debut in the ABA game at Zadar, which Partizan lost. Jones, Thompson, Vildoza and Jekiri didn't play there.
rumours.impact: Silva takes some center minutes from Tanaskovic. Partizan's coach is no longer a pick for you anyway.

review: Scorecard: no finished round to grade yet (R12 starts Tuesday 17 Nov). R11 (unofficial, our count) came to about 168, led by Vezenkov (C) 57 and coach Penarroya (PAR) +20. Calls holding up: selling Madar (broken nose, still doubtful for Olympiacos) and Faye → Diop (Booker out 2–4 months). The new risk is Onyema joining Milan, which could cut Diop's minutes as early as Tuesday. No flip-flop: same plan as yesterday, because no news since then changes it. Research: 26 searches, 3 pages read, 1 player unverified (Diop's domestic game). This weekend's domestic games are played later today, after this report.
window_plan: I'd make rebuild 1: sell Nunn, Herrera, Davidovac, Joksimović and Diarra; buy Payne, Frisch, Procida, Valančiūnas and Llull, with coach Martinez (RMB). Valančiūnas is the clear upgrade at center, and Procida and Frisch are minutes-backed cheap enablers. Diop goes too if Onyema is registered and takes his minutes in R12; check Llull against Campazzo's and Maledon's returns. Prices shift after R12–R13, so I'll redo this on 21 Nov.
